name: Auto Triage Issue
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
permissions:
  issues: write
jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Auto triage issue
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          # Load event payload
          payload=$(cat "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          title=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.issue.title')
          body=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.issue.body // ""')
          issue_number=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.issue.number')
          repo_full=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.repository.full_name')
          owner=$(echo "$repo_full" | cut -d'/' -f1)
          repo=$(echo "$repo_full" | cut -d'/' -f2)

          # Combine title and body for keyword search
          text="${title} ${body}"
          text_lower=$(echo "$text" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')

          # Determine issue type
          bug_keywords="bug error crash broken fix fail wrong regression"
          feature_keywords="feat feature enhancement add implement request improve"
          type="feature-request"  # default
          if echo "$text_lower" | grep -qE "\\b($bug_keywords)\\b"; then
            type="bug"
          elif echo "$text_lower" | grep -qE "\\b($feature_keywords)\\b"; then
            type="feature-request"
          fi

          # Determine priority
          high_keywords="critical urgent blocker blocking severe p0 p1"
          low_keywords="minor trivial \"nice to have\" \"low priority\" p3 p4"
          priority="priority: medium"  # default
          if echo "$text_lower" | grep -qE "\\b($high_keywords)\\b"; then
            priority="priority: high"
          elif echo "$text_lower" | grep -qE "\\b($low_keywords)\\b"; then
            priority="priority: low"
          fi

          # Label colors
          declare -A label_colors
          label_colors[bug]="d73a4a"
          label_colors[feature-request]="a2eeef"
          label_colors[priority:\ high]="d73a4a"
          label_colors[priority:\ medium]="fef2c0"
          label_colors[priority:\ low]="d4c5f9"

          # Fetch existing labels
          existing_labels=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$owner/$repo/labels" | jq -r '.[].name')

          # Create label if missing
          create_label_if_missing() {
            local name="$1"
            local color="${label_colors[$name]}"
            if ! echo "$existing_labels" | grep -Fxq "$name"; then
              curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
                -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
                -d "{\"name\":\"$name\",\"color\":\"$color\"}" \
                "https://api.github.com/repos/$owner/$repo/labels"
            fi
          }

          # Ensure all required labels exist
          create_label_if_missing "bug"
          create_label_if_missing "feature-request"
          create_label_if_missing "priority: high"
          create_label_if_missing "priority: medium"
          create_label_if_missing "priority: low"

          # Add labels to the issue
          labels_array=$(printf '%s\n' "$type" "$priority" | jq -R . | jq -s .)
          curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            -d "{\"labels\": $labels_array}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$owner/$repo/issues/$issue_number/labels"
